usage: clearlog solvegoal failgoal solvetask failtask nextphase increasecount clearallcooldowns
longdesc:
Quest Debug commands
clearlog : wipes out the questjournal
solvegoal goalhash : solves goal with hash goalhash if in current phase
failgoal goalhash : fails task with goal with goalhash
solvetask taskhash: solve task with hash taskhash
failtask taskhash : fails task with hash taskhash
nextphase taskhash : solves all goals in current phase of task with hash taskhash
increasecount goalhash : increases the repeat count of goal with hash goalhash
cooldownincrease cooldown-name minutes-to-add : increases the time limit of the cooldown
cooldowndecrease cooldown-name minutes-to-remove : decreases the time limit of the cooldownclearallcooldowns : clears all quest cooldowns
params: clearlog: Clears the QuestJournal | solvegoal: Literal: Solves goal with this hash | failgoal: Literal: Fails task with goal with this hash | solvetask: Literal: Solves task with this hash | failtask: Literal: Fails task with this hash | nextphase: Literal: Solves all goals in current phase for task with this hash | increasecount: Literal: Increases repeat count of goal with this hash | clearallcooldowns: Literal: clears all quest cooldowns
